import json, pathlib, subprocess
repo=pathlib.Path(r"E:\WebAIBridge")
files=[
"app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1",
"app/scripts/pause-all-r40.cmd",
"app/scripts/pause-browser-r40.cmd",
"app/scripts/resume-attach-r40.cmd",
"app/scripts/resume-managed-r40.cmd",
]
out=[]
for rel in files:
    exp=subprocess.check_output(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"show","HEAD:"+rel])
    act=(repo/rel).read_bytes()
    first=None
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(exp,act)):
        if a!=b:
            first=i; break
    if first is None and len(exp)!=len(act):
        first=min(len(exp),len(act))
    out.append({
        "file":rel,
        "equalRaw":exp==act,
        "expectedLen":len(exp),
        "actualLen":len(act),
        "firstDiff":first,
        "expectedFirst12":exp[:12].hex(" "),
        "actualFirst12":act[:12].hex(" "),
        "expectedCRLF":exp.count(b"\r\n"),
        "actualCRLF":act.count(b"\r\n"),
        "expectedLF":exp.count(b"\n"),
        "actualLF":act.count(b"\n"),
        "expectedTail":exp[-12:].hex(" "),
        "actualTail":act[-12:].hex(" "),
    })
print(json.dumps(out))
